registration_class: Local file saved before GODSEED harness execution; not an externally timestamped preregistration
source_revision_policy: Every run captures git revision and SHA256 manifest of implementation/protocol files; preserve failed run directories

experiments.hypothesis: Separate address/derivation/value/run identities are stable and distinct
experiments.controls: Same value from different programs; reordered JSON; NaN/unsafe numeric negative controls
experiments.falsification_threshold: All defined equalities hold, zero conflations

experiments.hypothesis: Typed composition/effects normalize and execute deterministically
experiments.controls: Valid/invalid types, branches, repeats, unknown operators, rights negatives
experiments.falsification_threshold: Zero invalid acceptances in specified corpus; identical pure replay

experiments.hypothesis: Seven SEURL labels require contextual, loss-aware mappings
experiments.controls: All seven verbs from actual historical parser and handoff
experiments.falsification_threshold: No false universal equivalence; all ambiguity/loss explicitly preserved

experiments.controls: Exhaustive 2-bit positive toggle/negative swap; definedness/effect negatives
experiments.falsification_threshold: Positive accepted; negative witnesses returned and compiler rejects

experiments.hypothesis: An AI-authored program can be built/tested/published and reused via URL
experiments.controls: Pure PURL and authored JS through restricted Docker; fresh HTTP client
experiments.falsification_threshold: Same expected output, immutable release and discoverable provenance

experiments.hypothesis: Execution and authority boundaries fail closed
experiments.falsification_threshold: Zero unauthorized writes or host accesses; resource attacks terminated; unavailable checks marked blocked

experiments.hypothesis: Three isolated clients reconstruct and continue persisted checkpoint state lawfully
experiments.controls: A owner, B attenuated proposal/checkpoint grants, C read-only reconstruction
experiments.falsification_threshold: Replay valid, revoked/grant negatives refused; same-provider process/agent class explicit

experiments.hypothesis: Concurrent tic-tac-toe validates turns and survives restart
experiments.controls: Two authenticated players, stale race, illegal turn, winner and replay
experiments.falsification_threshold: One concurrent winner commit, illegal writes rejected, replay matches after restart

experiments.hypothesis: God-seed PURL exposes typed mission graph and reconstructible cursor
experiments.controls: Fresh no-transcript agent sees one URL; compare plain directive and static graph
experiments.falsification_threshold: Directive accessible, ready nodes derivable, checkpoint/version discoverable; no fabricated advantage

experiments.hypothesis: Cold product/container/UI rebuild preserves persistence and core flows
experiments.controls: Clean checkout, migrations, API/worker images, Playwright desktop+Android, reduced motion, axe, restart/interrupted jobs
experiments.falsification_threshold: Working compile/build/run/publish and copy paths; no serious/critical a11y; no mobile overflow; measured local performance; production blockers explicit
